continuity: Jin Taekyung is alive but critically injured after taking a strike meant for Jeok Cheongang; he appeals to the System, whose chime answers at the chapter’s end.
Jeok Cheongang unleashes immense white fire after Taekyung saves him, incinerating Golden Ox Palace and confronting the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, who shields himself with death energy.
plot: Jin Taekyung throws himself between Jeok Cheongang and a strike, taking a grievous wound to save his Master. Grief and rage draw out Jeok’s latent power, and he unleashes a vast white fire dragon that incinerates Golden Ox Palace and forces the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord to defend himself with death energy.

Critically injured and losing his senses, Taekyung reflects that the gamble may have saved Jeok, but fears dying before he can see his loved ones again. He begs the System for more time, and a clear chime rings out just as he does.
translation_decisions: Retain “Force” for 강기 and “death energy” for 사기; the chapter distinguishes them.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is critically injured after saving Jeok Cheongang and appeals to the System; a chime sounds in response.
Jeok Cheongang has unleashed immense white fire against the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord; Golden Ox Palace was engulfed by it.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord is shielding himself with death energy and continues his revenge.

Can Jeok Cheongang defeat the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord?

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** He deeply trusts Jin Taekyung, his publicly acknowledged Disciple and intended heir, regards him as the light of his later years, and will stand by him whatever path he chooses; he warmly regards Ju Hwaran, sees Mae Jonghak as a kindred spirit, recognizes Cheongpung as Mae's grandson and successor, was close to Hong Dao, accepted Jangcheon as a Disciple before he became Jopil, and remains Peng Cheolhu's rival.
